title: Initial tower defense game
summary: Pixel-art TD with 3 tower types (Pea Shooter, Slop Cannon, Zapper), 3 enemy types (Walker, Sneaker, Wanderer), 10 waves, A* pathfinding, grid-based wall/tower placement, and programmatic pixel art sprites.

title: GitHub Pages deployment
summary: GitHub Actions workflow auto-deploys to Pages on push to main. Vite base path configured for /moodles/.

title: Tower upgrades and sell/refund
summary: Three upgrade stats per tower (range, speed, damage) with 3 levels each. Click tower to select, upgrade or sell for 60% refund. Speed controls (1x/2x/3x) and auto-start checkbox.

title: Programmatic audio: SFX and chiptune music
summary: All audio generated with Web Audio API oscillators. Unique SFX per tower type, enemy death, placement, upgrade, sell, wave start, win/lose. Multi-section chiptune music with procedural variation at 145 BPM.

title: Guaranteed path redesign
summary: Removed tower/wall destruction and flyers. Path from spawn to goal is always visible and can never be fully blocked. Placement rejected if it would kill the only route. Locked path cells shown in red.

title: Major polish pass: juice, new content, endless mode
summary: 3 new towers (Frost, Chain, Coin Tree), 3 new enemies (Tank, Sprinter, Healer). Particle effects, screen shake, tower recoil, enemy hit flash, projectile trails. Endless mode after wave 10. Scoring with localStorage high score.

title: WebRTC co-op multiplayer
summary: Two-player co-op via PeerJS (WebRTC peer-to-peer). Lobby with Host/Join/Solo options. Short room codes (MOODLE-XXXX). Host authoritative, guest sends commands. Independent per-player economies. Dual cursor display.

title: Co-op networking reliability
summary: Host simulation and broadcasts run on setInterval (not rAF) to avoid browser throttling for background tabs. Guest preserves local UI state across state syncs. Ownership enforced for tower/wall selection and commands.

title: Economy rebalance
summary: Halved all kill rewards and wave bonus. Wall selling added (click to select, sell for 60% refund). Upgrades properly deduct from owner's coin pool in multiplayer.

title: Co-op restart
summary: Either player can restart on game over. Guest sends restart command to host. Connection preserved across restarts. Green Play Again button on game over screen.
